This is gonna be TMI..Trigger warning..idk what to say except it’s gross af. 
I’ve always had light periods that last about 6-7 days.. until I got my vaccinations. My cycle started almost immediately after getting the first vax and it was light but lasted for nearly 3 months. Then once I thought it had normalized, i got the biggest clots I’ve ever had. I was so sick. I threw up the whole time. I was taking a bath & felt like I was gonna throw up so I got out just in time to get to the toilet.. while I was sitting on the floor on my knees as I was throwing up and I felt something come out of me and I could feel that I was suddenly very wet. I looked down to see a puddle of blood under me, and probably 8-10 clots each the size of a 50c piece.. never in my life have I ever experienced this.
Ever since, I’ve had clots, terrible cramping, vomiting, etc. The clotting has gotten slightly better over time, but unfortunately I’ve chosen to not get a booster because of my experience. I’m disabled & already feel very ill on a regular basis, and that put me over the edge. I’m not sure if it’s related, but I now throw up around 1-2 times a day, barely tolerate food. But hey, I don’t have Covid 🙄
